title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into the Endpoint Changes report. Another user with the pci_analyst role could trigger the execution of attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands by interacting with the report. This occurs because the report does not properly treat dynamic values as literal search inputs, allowing command injection with the permissions of the clicking user.
